message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV files and applies filters/column operations but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data before use.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from a local filesystem path with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks of any kind.
No detected label flipping detection: The code performs no label distribution comparison, label value validation, or noise-detection (e.g., Cleanlab) at any point in the data preparation flow.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The only filtering applied is a bounding-box geographic filter for Santiago; there are no outlier detection routines, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering to defend against poisoned samples.
No detected model integrity verification: The code does not load any pretrained weights or serialized model; it builds a LightGBM model from scratch with no hash, signature, or revision verification.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms (e.g., neural cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection) are present in the code.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses LightGBM and PySpark ML without any differential privacy library or DP-SGD mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, or any adversarial attack/robustness testing framework anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although sklearn's train_test_split and accuracy_score/confusion_matrix are imported, there is no visible enforcement of test-set isolation from training, no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and no use of multiple independent metrics in the truncated code shown.

No detected input sanitization: The code reads CSV files and applies spatial filters (lat/lon bounds) but performs no schema validation, type checking, or input sanitization before passing data to the model.

No detected output bounds checks: The truncated code shows use of accuracy_score and confusion_matrix but no checks on model output probabilities, NaN guards, or threshold validation before returning predictions.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses LightGBM on tabular WiFi geolocation data, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and not present.
